Suitable storage

Store your belongings
during a move, renovation or time away.

Storage can hold furniture, personal belongings or records when you move abroad, downsize or renovate.

CODEM calculates the volume with you and designs a solution for the duration you need. Storage type, collection and delivery can be included in your request.

  • Storage boxes for households
  • Solutions for business records
  • Belongings protected from dust and damp

The right care.
The right preparation.

01

The right space, for the right duration.

Tell us which furniture and boxes need storing, your arrival date and expected duration. CODEM can then prepare a suitable proposal.

02

Prepare belongings before storage.

Packing, furniture protection and inventory are arranged according to your selected services. Mention fragile or specialist items so their handling can be assessed.

03

Plan the return.

Access, collection and delivery to your new address are agreed with CODEM. Your quote confirms the storage terms relevant to your needs.
